subject: music
title: Structure & Silence
welcome_lead: Verses, choruses and the power of rests.
meta_desc: KS3 elements: structure, form, silence and rests.
final_note: Structure is the skeleton holding a song together.

concepts.def: Section with the story, words change.

walkthroughs.body_html: Most pop songs use a verse-chorus structure. Verses tell the story (lyrics change). The chorus is the catchy hook that returns.
Classical music labels sections with letters. Binary form = AB. Ternary form = ABA — back to the opening idea after a contrast.
A rest is silent beats. Music without rests is exhausting to hear. A well-placed rest creates tension, surprise or breathing space.
